purpose: One measured cut inside the project-file visitor after dependency-source inference skip. Do not skip project-file body inference.

cut.path: method_lookup_chain used by FactCollector infer_type / call references
cut.why: Symbolized sequential samply on example-workspace/server put method_lookup_chain at 43.3% of all samples. Each probe rebuilt MRO and cloned every unresolved graph edge into a HashSet (HashMap::insert 29.7%).
changes: SemanticGraph maintains an explicit unresolved-source count index; has_explicit_unresolved_edge_from is O(1) and covers Include/Prepend/Extend as well as Superclass. ImplicitObject provenance is excluded.
method_lookup_chain reuses a thread-local 8192-entry FIFO keyed by engine identity, matching method-return memoization. Hits are O(1) and do not touch FIFO order. Identity changes drop the entries.
Resolve-path MethodLookupChainCache remains the borrowed FqnId slice cache. Do not share one chain HashMap across a parallel file batch.
not_done: Do not restore unresolved_edges().collect() on every lookup.
Do not share AnalysisQueryCache or this chain map across a parallel 512-file batch.
Do not skip TypeTracker / higher-order / local flow / inferred returns on project files.
Do not raise the 8192 cap without an RSS measurement.

notes: replace_facts per file changes engine identity, so the thread-local chain cache is per-file; within-file reuse plus the unresolved-source index still dominate.

rss_note: Official two-project peak RSS remains above the fixed 1,776,846,438-byte ceiling on this branch and its parent. This cut did not raise process RSS on the warm repeat.
example_identity_note: Published workspace, symbol, and fixture identities are generic historical labels. Measurements are unchanged; retired fixture labels do not refer to the current synthetic regression.
